card.name: Badeline, Part of You
card.text: First strike Whenever Badeline, Part of You attacks or crews a Vehicle, other creatures you control gain +2/+0 until end of turn. Partner (You can have two commanders if both have partner.)

card.name: Madeline, Complete
card.text: Vigilance, double strike Whenever Madeline, Complete deals combat damage, draw a card. {BG}: Surveil 1. Madeline gains haste until end of turn.

card.name: Paralyzing Doubt
card.text: Tap target creature. Its controller discards a card at random from their hand.

card.name: Madeline, Troubled Climber
card.text: Haste, vigilance Whenever Madeline, Troubled Climber attacks or crews a vehicle, create a 3/2 black Avatar creature token with haste and vigilance. If Madeline is attacking, it enters attacking. Sacrifice it at the beginning of the next end step. Partner

card.name: Glistening Feather
card.text: Target creature gets +2/+2 and gains flying until end of turn.

card.name: Crystal Heart
card.text: Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn. Untap all creatures. Each player draws a card. Exile Crystal Heart.

card.name: Theo, Adventurous Sightseer
card.text: Whenever a creature enters under your control, if it does not share at least one creature type with other creatures you control, it enters with an additional two +1/+1 counters on it. Whenever a permanent enters under your control, if it does not share at least one card type with other permanents you control, proliferate, then proliferate again.

card.name: Wavebounce
card.text: Target creature gains vigilance and haste until end of turn.

card.name: Lucid Dreams
card.text: Draw X cards, where X is the number of card types among cards in your graveyard.

card.name: Summit's Release
card.text: Gain 7 life. Untap target creature. Put a +1/+1 counter on it. Destroy up to one target enchantment.

card.name: Miasmic Seeker
card.text: Flying At the beginning of each combat, Miasmic Seeker gets +1/+0 for each card type among cards in all graveyards until end of turn

card.name: Soulbird
card.text: Bestow {3}{U} Flying When Soulbird or enchanted creature dies, draw a card. Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has flying.

card.name: Old Woman of the Mount
card.text: Tap an untapped creature with haste you control: Creatures you control get +2/+1 until end of turn. Tap an untapped Avatar you control: Draw a card. {T}: Surveil 1

card.name: Unnerving Reflection
card.text: Target player mills seven cards. Delirium — Then if there are four or more card types among cards in your graveyard, draw two cards.

card.name: Star Jam
card.text: Enchant creature Enchanted creature gets +2/+0 and has haste. Whenever enchanted creature attacks, scry 2.

card.name: Jolting Idol
card.text: Double strike Crew 2 (Tap any number of creatures you control with total power 2 or more: This Vehicle becomes an artifact creature until end of turn.)

card.name: Belligerent Idol
card.text: Trample When Belligerent Idol becomes blocked by a creature with defender, destroy that creature. Crew 1

card.name: Three Thousand Meters
card.text: Whenever a creature you control attacks or deals combat damage to a player, put a flag counter on Three Thousand Meters. Then if there are 30 or more flag counters on Three Thousand Meters, you win the game.

card.name: Walking on Clouds
card.text: Creatures you control have reach. At the beginning of combat on your turn, target creature you control gains flying until end of turn.

card.name: Blissful Return
card.text: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures. Those creatures gain lifelink until end of turn.

card.name: Prison of Crystal
card.text: Enchant creature Enchanted creature can't attack and loses all abilities. As a sorcery, enchanted creature's controller may tap four untapped creatures they control. If they do, sacrifice Prison of Crystal.

card.name: Malicious Sludge Bunny
card.text: Deathtouch Whenever Malicious Sludge Bunny deals combat damage, create a 1/1 black Pest creature token.

card.name: Celeste Mountain
card.text: When Celeste Mountain enters, sacrifice it unless you pay {1}. {T}: Add {U} or {R}. {1}{U}{R}, {T}: Each player creates a token that is a copy of target Non-Avatar creature they control except it is a legendary Avatar in addition to its other colors and types.

card.name: Self-Worthlessness
card.text: Flying, first strike At the beginning of your upkeep, return target permanent you control to its owner's hand. At the beginning of your end step, if you control an even number of permanents, transform Self-Worthlessness.

card.name: Mr. Oshiro
card.text: Flying, prowess At the beginning of your upkeep, exile target permanent, then return it to the battlefield under its owner's control. At the beginning of your end step, if you control an odd number of permanents, transform Mr. Oshiro.
